Brahmanvaad Jindabad.. 
Also, Brahmanvaad Jindabad.
Same same but very very different...Real Brahmanvaad is non-caste. 

🥸 Those who are using it purely like identity pride... 🤡 this emoji is for you.

But adding "-vaad" to everything else? 

What is Baniyavaad bro?
 Like kuch bhi! 🥱Wrapping modern corporate concepts, financial systems, or knowledge frameworks in old labels doesn't make sense anymore. 

Today's professional world operates on merit and economic realities, not historical tags.
